name: Diego Medina
life: “I still remember marking the first no-traffic morning on a paper calendar.” On Sunday, near the corner by Juniper Tailor, Diego looks at the things people actually bring in for repair before looking in the display window.
voice: I count the cars from my porch. The day the shared ride starts will look like one ordinary car missing.
appearance: On an ordinary day, look for a brown corduroy jacket and a small enamel bird on the lapel. Diego has a straight nose and deep-set eyes, with dark brown curls cut close behind the ears. Diego listens with the head tilted a little to the left during a conversation.
personality: Diego finds names easy and faces hard on a crowded street. People who assume they have been snubbed usually get a warmer greeting once they speak.
agenda: To mark the change in traffic on the porch calendar.
family: Oliver Aranda is Diego’s stepsibling. Diego is free to hang up first. Oliver makes the call. Some of their best calls last less than a minute. A change of tone is sometimes all the news either one needs. Asked about *The worker who couldn't read the joke*, Oliver says, “I wanted the photo gone. My kid wanted a copy so we could talk about when it's hard to disagree in public.”
connections: Santiago Wells. One passenger hears a quiet journey while a resident sees the missing car in the street.
